subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Personal details: name, address, telephone number and age

show.line: I know my name, my age and where I live. These are my details!

rounds.prompt: What is your name? Say: my name is, and your name.
Which one shows where you live?
rounds.praise: Your address tells where you live.

rounds.prompt: Which do we use to phone home?
rounds.praise: A phone! Learn your phone number.

rounds.prompt: Who can you tell your address to? A stranger or a teacher?

hints: Your address is your street and number.
Only share details with grown-ups you trust.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A stranger asks where I live.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Only tell grown-ups you trust.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: We only share our address with people we trust!

parent_line: Knows own name, age, address and that details are shared only with trusted adults.
